name_reason: Name follows the convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> shared by all sibling chapter end-scene tables (data_fd2_chapter_chNN_end_scene_char_pos_{x,y}_table / _facing_table). 'ch03' is the chapter-3 domain ID (valid, not a Ghidra address residue), 'pos_y' reflects the Y-tile-coordinate semantic, '_table' reflects the array data type. Verified the Y semantic: in fd2_chapter_03_end @ 0x230F2 this table is the 2nd of three parallel 7-byte blocks (X @ 0x520BA, Y @ 0x520C1, facing @ 0x520C8) copied onto the stack and passed as recruit_block_b (2nd arg) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro. globals.h:88 declares it [7] '7 chars Y'.
purpose: Chapter-3 end-scene character placement: per-character Y tile coordinate for the 7 characters staged in the ch03 recruit cutscene (recruit 劍士鐵諾, char #2).
logic_summary: Second of three parallel 7-byte const tables (X @ 0x520BA, Y @ 0x520C1, facing @ 0x520C8). fd2_chapter_03_end block-copies these 7 bytes (MOVSD/MOVSW/MOVSB) into an on-stack placement block (recruit_block_b), then hands the three blocks to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which consumes one byte per character slot to stage the recruit cutscene. Read-only: single READ xref from fd2_chapter_03_end @ 0x23117 (plus DATA fixup @ 0x23112), no writer.
element_semantics: Each byte = the Y battle/map tile coordinate for one of the 7 staged characters (slot index 0..6). Values: {3,3,3,2,2,4,1}.
notes: src/table/chtab.c comment block (lines 214-234) was already accurate, precise, and current (purpose, parallel-table layout, caller MOVS block-copy, element type, read-only single-xref) so it was left unchanged (comment_verdict=keep); no Edit to src. Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT at 0x520C1 was empty (null) so a concise plate carrying the same conclusion was created via run_script_inline (PLATE_NOW_LEN=569). Memory {3,3,3,2,2,4,1} matches the C initializer and globals.h [7] declaration. No logic changed.
